reference_trajectory.basis: series_rtol matches the upstream's own TRAJECTORY_RTOL (ODE solver rtol 1e-3 to 1e-4). Milestone times use an absolute 0.01 year (about 4 days) instead of the upstream's relative 1e-3, which on a calendar year allows about 2 years.

seeded_distribution.basis: Sampling noise only. Each quantile passes when |ours - published| <= z * sqrt(se_ours^2 + se_pub^2); se_ours by bootstrap over our draws, se_pub scaled from it by sqrt(n_ours/n_pub). Achievement rates use z pooled binomial standard errors. It does not absorb code changes between the published run and the pinned commit; those show up as failures and are reported, not tolerated.
